messages:
maria: Quick regional rollout note: EU-only header toggle + model-variant pin. Need quick thumbs from runtime, api, router, console. Plan: canary 3% -> 20% -> 100% (EU). rollback triggers: cpu >75% for 5m OR api 5xx >0.7% over 10m.

sam: runtime: confirm this only affects header-based model selection and a short-lived feature flag?

maria: correct. header `X-Model-Select-Alt` + runtime flag `model_select_alt_enabled`. flag default OFF; enable for canary shards.

oliver: router: will add passthrough rule for eu shards; no global strip. adding temporary shard tag `canary-eu-1`.

kai: api: accept both headers; instrument header usage metric per route.

jen: drafting release notes: "EU opt-in: header toggle + model variant pin". will publish after pin locked.

maria: deploybot preflight please. need infra health, canary slot, monitors, dead-man TTL.

deploybot: preflight started for 'eu-header-pin' wave. infra ok, slot ok, monitors hooked, dead-man TTL set 30m.

maria: checklist: router rule (oliver), runtime flag staged (sam), api metrics (kai), console opt-in (ara), docs (jen), deploybot armed (maria).

oliver: rule applied to eu-west shards; passthrough active on `canary-eu-1`.

sam: runtime toggle merged but OFF. will flip ON for canary once deploybot starts.

kai: synthetic to eu canary shows new header usage in staging. pushing small traffic now.

maria: starting 3% EU canary. deploybot, start wave.

deploybot: wave started  eu-header-pin  canary=3%  initiated by maria  ts=7162223360

jen: watching release-notes PR rnotes/3224.

ara: console opt-ins quiet; error dashboard clear.

oliver: router metrics steady. no routing errors or latency change.

sam: flipped runtime flag ON for canary shards; monitoring kv hitrate and selection histograms.

kai: api 10m: 5xx=0.2%, new-header usage 2.1%. safe to proceed in 12m to 20% unless objections.

maria: thumbs up. next step at +12m. rollback CLI: `deploybot rollback --wave=eu-header-pin --reason=errs`

jen: rollback steps in notes: pin console to v1, remove canary shard tag, set runtime flag OFF after 10m drain, unpublish docs if needed.

sam: note: after rollback wait 10m to drain, then rotate flag off. will prepare short-lived metrics tag to separate traffic windows.

deploybot: scheduled increase to 20% at ts=7162224080 (12m). monitors: cpu, 5xx_rate, header_usage. dead-man TTL active.

maria: thanks all — i'll post update when 20% finishes. :rocket:
